$description: Single source of truth for the kit's design tokens (DTCG format). Edit this file, then run `npm run tokens:build`. Never hand-edit global.css, lib/theme.ts or tokens/generated/*. Colour values are hex; the build converts them for CSS. Semantic colour tokens carry a { light, dark } value. Numbers are px unless noted.

space.$description: 4-pt grid. Tailwind's numeric scale (p-1 = 4, p-4 = 16) is the vocabulary; these are the allowed steps.

family.$description: Empty string = platform system font (SF on iOS, Roboto on Android). To use a brand font, embed it with the expo-font config plugin (see README › Branding) and put the family name here.

heading.$description: Headings (Text h1–h4, titles). Empty = the platform system font.

body.$description: Everything else. Empty = the platform system font.

semantic.$description: The only tokens components may use. Names follow the shadcn/ui vocabulary so react-native-reusables components, Figma kits and LLM output all agree. Each colour has a light and a dark value.

button.$description: The primary button: bg-button (its alpha is button.alpha). Follows the theme's button style.

button-foreground.$description: Text and icons on the primary button: text-button-foreground.

button-edge.$description: The primary button's border and bottom edge: border-button-edge.

field.$description: Text fields: bg-field (its alpha is field.alpha). Follows the theme's field style.

field-edge.$description: Text fields' border or bottom line: border-field-edge.

radius.$description: Base corner radius; Tailwind derives rounded-sm/md/lg/xl from it.

control.$description: Corner radius of controls (buttons, inputs, chips): rounded-control. 9999 = pills.

width.$description: Width of `border` (px). border-2 and border-hairline stay explicit.

stroke.$description: Lucide stroke width; an icon's own strokeWidth is relative to 2.

1.$description: shadow-xs / shadow-sm / shadow: controls and cards.

3.$description: shadow-lg / shadow-xl: menus, dialogs, floating buttons.

scale.$description: Web: multiplies the spacing scale (Tailwind 4 --spacing). Mobile: see density.control.

md.$description: Mobile: control height (h-control): buttons, inputs, selects, px.

size.$description: Typeset: body text size (px). Every text size (text-xs…4xl) scales by size / 16.

leading.$description: Typeset: line height of running text (× size); the text sizes' line heights scale by leading / 1.75.

flow.$description: Typeset: space between blocks of long-form text (Prose), em.

measure.$description: Typeset: the longest line of long-form text (Prose), characters.

alpha.$description: Opacity of the primary button's fill (0 = an outline button).

edge-width.$description: Primary button bottom edge (px); raised buttons have a thicker, darker one.

alpha.$description: Opacity of a text field's fill, per mode.

border-width.$description: Text field border, top and sides (px).

round.$description: 1 = text fields take the md radius on top, 0 = square.

round-bottom.$description: 1 = text fields take the md radius at the bottom, 0 = square.

inset.$description: 1 = text fields have inner padding, 0 = flush (underline fields).

sm.$description: Button: small height (px; phones raise a touch target under 44 to 44).

md.$description: Button: height (px; phones raise a touch target under 44 to 44).

size.$description: Button: text size (px), from its text style.

leading.$description: Button: line height (px), fitted to the control.

pressed.$description: Button primary: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Button primary: pressed and hover opacity.

ring.$description: Button primary: focus ring colour (a role or the border, faded).

pressed.$description: Button secondary: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Button secondary: pressed and hover opacity.

ring.$description: Button secondary: focus ring colour (a role or the border, faded).

pressed.$description: Button outline: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Button outline: pressed and hover opacity.

ring.$description: Button outline: focus ring colour (a role or the border, faded).

pressed.$description: Button ghost: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Button ghost: pressed and hover opacity.

ring.$description: Button ghost: focus ring colour (a role or the border, faded).

pressed.$description: Button destructive: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Button destructive: pressed and hover opacity.

ring.$description: Button destructive: focus ring colour (a role or the border, faded).

sm.$description: Button: small gap between an icon and the label (px).

md.$description: Button: gap between an icon and the label (px).

lg.$description: Button: large gap between an icon and the label (px).

focus-border.$description: Button: border colour when focused (the focus ring role).

sm.$description: Chip: small height (px; phones raise a touch target under 44 to 44).

size.$description: Chip: text size (px), from its text style.

leading.$description: Chip: line height (px), fitted to the control.

pressed.$description: Chip unselected: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Chip unselected: pressed and hover opacity.

pressed.$description: Chip selected: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Chip selected: pressed and hover opacity.

md.$description: Chip: gap between an icon and the label (px).

icon.$description: Chip: icon size (px); unset, each kit draws its own.

size.$description: Badge: text size (px), from its text style.

leading.$description: Badge: line height (px), fitted to the control.

pressed.$description: Badge default: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Badge default: pressed and hover opacity.

pressed.$description: Badge secondary: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Badge secondary: pressed and hover opacity.

pressed-alpha.$description: Badge destructive: pressed and hover opacity.

pressed.$description: Badge outline: pressed and hover fill (derived from the fill unless set).

pressed-alpha.$description: Badge outline: pressed and hover opacity.

sm.$description: Badge: small height (px; phones raise a touch target under 44 to 44).

md.$description: Badge: height (px; phones raise a touch target under 44 to 44).
Badge: gap between an icon and the label (px).

sm.$description: Input: small height (px; phones raise a touch target under 44 to 44).
